headline: US Flash PMI Data Indicates Economic Expansion Moderated Slightly in November
summary: Preliminary PMI figures from S&P Global showed business activity in the United States continued to grow in November, though the overall pace of expansion slowed modestly.
why: Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) data provides early insights into private sector output, order volumes, and employment trends.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: PMI survey data signals continued moderate output expansion across manufacturing and service sectors.
